  • 英語名: Midare Setsugetsuka Tsukiyo no Inbu, Kyouki no Chigiri

あらすじ

Part 1:

Reexperience the tale of “Petals of the Wild Snow Moon Faint, Fluttering Snowfall” in a series of side stories told from the perspective of Kiichi Kusakabe.

Will the truth behind Kiichi’s transformation… finally come to light?!

Part 2:

Two months have passed from the events in the previous part.

item.title: Midare Setsugetsuka ~Hakanaku Chiru Sasameyuki~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Lass Lunatic
  • 発売日: 2015-11-27
  • スコア: 6.65/10 (39 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 乱れ雪月華 ～儚く散る細雪～
  • 英語名: Midare Setsugetsuka Hakanaku Chiru Sasameyuki

あらすじ

Kunoichi… Women who follow the ways of the ninja.

As time passed, they fulfilled their duties, and so they vanished into the shadows of history… or so it seemed.

But even in the modern era, all these centuries later, the bloodline of the kunoichi has not died out.

In the city of Kashiro, in the Kuragami residence, there live four young people.
